extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Text-layer PDF (no glyph spreading). Grid read from pdftotext -bbox tokens binned into cells whose boundaries were recovered from 200-dpi raster rule lines (§1d); mechanical matrix agreed with the visual read cell-for-cell. Footnotes a-e read from document page 12 (beyond the declared SoA range, per PAGEMAP). Footnotes d, f, g are referenced in the table but their text is redacted (CCI). Two full-width redaction bars on page 11 may hide activity rows (see review item D1).

table_metadata.table_purpose: Main schedule: screening, in-clinic treatment period Days -1 to 18 (rosuvastatin and pirtobrutinib administration, rosuvastatin PK sampling), and FU/ED visit on Day 24
table_metadata.notes: Section 1.3. One printed table whose rows run from page 10 onto page 11 under a reprinted header; extracted as one table (the header is not duplicated). 1 label column; data columns 2-22. Footnote text is on page 12.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band: 'Screening' (upper line of the rotated col-2 cell, which spans header rows 1-2), 'Treatment Period (Study Days)' merged across cols 3-21, and 'FU/ED' (follow-up / early discontinuation) in col 22. Study phases -> epoch. The label column holds 'Study Procedure' merged across both header rows, so the property name is synthesized.

Study day per column: '(D-42 to -2)' for Screening (lower line of the rotated col-2 cell), -1, 1-18 for the Treatment Period, and '24 (± 2 days)' for FU/ED. Values are protocol study days (the band header reads 'Study Days') -> study_day; the ± 2 day window is kept inside the FU/ED cell value as printed. Name synthesized (label column empty for this row).

annotations.annotation_text: Participants will be discharged from the CRU on Day 18 once all study procedures are completed.

Participants will attend an outpatient follow-up visit 7 (± 2) days after the final dose of study intervention. If participants are not able to attend the CRU for this visit, the CRU should contact the participant via phone call to conduct adverse event and concomitant medication review. If applicable, ED assessments should be performed on the day of discontinuation (or as close to it as possible).
Female participants only. Serum pregnancy test at screening and urine pregnancy test at all other times.
